title: Exclude funded P104 donor source banks (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** The tested route would replace role 1355’s chart-240 split with a direct rank-six MOVE and source its missing −2 x863 correction immediately before or after the direct route. At the first boundary, the chart-739 source bank is empty. At the second, all 673 eligible chart-127 fields have exact zero x863 coefficient. An independent literal fused-prefix replay confirms the same bank and that the missing correction is exactly −2 x863. The coordinate functional excludes every rational source combination in either bank. Zero cases remain unresolved.

The unchanged complete 17-copy invoice and the optimistic fusion credit of 0.16685897749686654 raw are pinned through #7335. Adding a paid rank-one position would erase that credit. After the source gate, compatible saving is zero. #7335 addresses output response through chart-240 recipients and uses a different separator. The distinct helper-319 construction in #7334 is a peer claim with its own verification.

## Reproduce

~~~sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-funded-donor-source-span/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-funded-donor-source-span
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-funded-donor-source-span --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

Both exact replay engines, registered checks, committed bytes/modes/source history, Git-free export and six navigation tests passed locally. The original capped solver receipt is preserved, and the bounded coordinate continuation resolves the second bank. Changed caller and stale price are rejected. Earlier source banks and altered chronology remain open. Exact comparator #7314 at 9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91, with the exact #7113 caller. The branch retains the #7257 replay prerequisites.
